name: Hallmark
summary: Agent design skill that builds, audits and redesigns web pages so they do not look AI-generated.
description: A SKILL.md rule-set with references for coding agents: it picks a page macrostructure for the brief, applies one of 21 themes (or a custom palette, type and layout) and runs 57 slop-test gates plus a self-critique before handing back. Four verbs: build (default), audit (punch list, no edits), redesign, and study (extract a design's structure, type pairing and colour, optionally as a portable design.md).
contains: SKILL.md rule-set with references and worked examples
57 slop-test gates and a pre-emit self-critique
example pages as self-contained HTML + CSS
install paths for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
